# SharedFileSystem v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's sharedfilesystems/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.SharedFileSystemV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.shared_file_system`).

`conn.SharedFileSystemProjectQuotas(ctx, project)` and `CurrentSharedFileSystemProjectQuotas(ctx)` fix the Manila quota project. [Quotas](quotasets/README.md) covers Get/Defaults/Detail/Update/Reset and microversion-specific routes. These SDK-owned APIs are absent from pinned Gophercloud.

`service.QuotaClassSets.InClass(ctx, "default")` fixes the class name for Get/Update, without project resolution or List/Reset. [Quota classes](quotaclasssets/README.md) covers Python mappings, typed limits, and extension inputs.

Typed `ShareAccessRules.InShare(ctx, share)` lists accept `request.MaxItems(n)` and `request.Paginated(false)` consumption controls. Modern access endpoints return one collection, so no next links are followed and caps are not sent as wire limits. Calls recheck numeric version 2.45 or later and actual Manila service-type/version headers, preserving canonical lowercase response IDs and parents. [Access rules](shareaccessrules/README.md) covers Allow/Deny, waits, response evidence, and Python differences.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.SharedFileSystemV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Shares.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Shares.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
